component.name: Compx Control
component.summary: Native configuration for COMPX-based gaming mice

description.p: Compx Control is a native Linux companion for COMPX-based gaming mice such as the MAD R family and VXE R1. It talks to the mouse directly through its vendor HID collection, so no browser tab, Windows virtual machine or vendor service is required.

Configure the polling rate, up to eight DPI stages with per-stage colours, lift-off distance, debounce, sleep timer, Motion Sync, ripple control, sensor rotation, straight-line correction and the DPI indicator LED. The battery percentage can live in the system tray with three distinctive icon styles, and a small CLI makes the same settings scriptable.
Settings are stored on the mouse itself. The app works offline and sends no telemetry.

description.p: Adds hardware-verified VXE R1 Pro support through its 1K receiver and a receiver picker when multiple devices are connected.
First release with MAD R family support, 8K receiver support, tray integration and CLI.
